fieldguide.entity.vampirism.vampire.desc: An undead predator sustained by blood. Garlic can keep lesser vampires at bay, while silver and sunlight remain dependable preparations for a hunt.
fieldguide.entity.werewolves.human_werew: A lycanthrope caught between human will and the beast. Silver weapons punish the transformed body, and wolfsbane can disrupt a werewolf's strength and senses.
fieldguide.entity.cnc.wendigo.descriptio: A very rare nocturnal cryptid. Tracks, missing prey, and recovered remains are safer evidence than confronting one before the hunt is understood.
fieldguide.entity.cnc.chupacabra.descrip: A nocturnal livestock predator associated with drained animals, poison, and blood trails. Follow the evidence before it chooses another herd.
fieldguide.entity.mythsandlegends.imp.de: A fire-resistant Nether demon. Its apparent death may divide the threat instead of ending it, so hunters should watch for surviving fragments.
fieldguide.entity.vampirism.ghost.descri: A restless incorporeal spirit found in the supernatural ecology of Vampirism. Spiritual preparations are more reliable than ordinary force.
fieldguide.entity.eidolon_repraised.wrai: A ritual-linked undead spirit whose chilling touch rewards careful occult and spiritual preparation.
fieldguide.entity.graveyard.wraith.descr: A grave spirit that extinguishes nearby light. It is a distinct creature from the wraiths bound to Eidolon rites.
fieldguide.entity.occultism.iesnium_gole: An occult construct shaped from iesnium. Treat its forged body as a deliberate magical creation, not a naturally occurring beast.
